def diff(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; co=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    br=[(r,gi[r][0]) for r in range(H) if any(x!=0 for x in gi[r])]
    c0=[co[r][0] for r in range(H)]
    # minimal p with col0 period p
    p=min(q for q in range(1,H+1) if all(c0[(r)%q]==c0[r] for r in range(H)))
    mp=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in br: mp.setdefault(r%p,[]).append(c)
    print(k,'p',p)
    for i,cs in sorted(mp.items()): print('  rd',i,'bands',cs,'colors',[c0[r] for r in range(H) if r%p==i][:3],'count out',sum(1 for r in range(H) if r%p==i))

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I6=[r[0] for r in G['Demo pair 6 input'] if r[0]!=0]
O6=[r[0] for r in G['Demo pair 6 output']]
print('I6:',I6)
print('O6 period6 check:')
p=O6[:6]
print(all(O6[r]==p[r%6] for r in range(len(O6))))
# Find period of O6 exactly
for per in range(1,30):
    if all(O6[r]==O6[(r+per)%len(O6)] for r in range(len(O6)-per)):

# demo7 stripe sequences incl zeros-as-background? zeros ARE background (0).
I7z=[r[0] for r in G['Demo pair 7 input']]
O7z=[r[0] for r in G['Demo pair 7 output']]
print(I7z,O7z)
